caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, rounded jug made of stoneware, featuring a small neck, a wide body, and a handle attached from the neck to the upper shoulder. The jug is colored in varying shades of beige, gray, and light brown, with subtle changes in hue indicating shadow and form. On the upper front portion of the jug, there is a decorative blue-gray floral or leaf motif painted on the surface, along with an inscription in dark blue-gray that reads, “S.S. PERRY & CO WEST TROY 2.” The overall composition is centered, with the jug occupying the majority of the plain, light beige background. No other objects or designs are present in the drawing.
title: Earthenware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
